The Society for Obesity and Bariatric Anaesthesia (SOBA) is affiliated with the Association of Anaesthetists of Great Britain and Ireland (AAGBI) and formed and opened to membership in 2008. Its membership consists of expert clinicians who specialise in anaesthesia for bariatric surgery and in obese patients. The Society runs educational meetings both Nationally and Internationally which are recognised and approved by the Royal College of Anaesthetists (RCoA).

In addition the society has produced and published National Guidelines including a widely adopted Single Sheet Guidance, several review articles and a textbook.
